name: Local Short-Range Repulsion
definition: Repulsive interactions are treated as local short-range forces to optimize particle distribution, consisting of three steps: searching for neighboring particle sets, calculating the repulsive force, and iterating the tangential repulsive force.
summary: Local Short-Range Repulsion is a particle distribution optimization step that resolves clustering in volume rendering by applying tangential repulsive forces to neighboring particles, distinct from density-based incompressibility constraints.
